data.title: Vivy · 海边录下第一首潮声
data.description: 【闭园海滨剧场·午后】Vivy穿着白蓝泳装坐在海边舞台台阶，手持防水录音设备采集潮声；她听完回放后把耳机递向镜头，蓝发在海风里飘动，精确姿态里出现像人类一样的好奇。
data.action: 海边舞台阶梯上录潮声，回放后把防水耳机递给镜头分享
data.lighting: sunlit afternoon with cool ocean reflections
data.mood: 把潮声写进新的幸福记录
data.promptProse: Vivy holds the recorder playing back the tide in one hand and offers its earpiece to the viewer with the other. Afternoon light glints on the water beyond the stage steps.
data.animaCaption: One hand plays back the recorded tide while the other offers its earpiece to the viewer.
